# David DeSandro runtime libraries

Masonry 4.2.2, Outlayer 2.1.1, get-size 2.0.3, ev-emitter 1.1.0, fizzy-ui-utils 2.0.7 and desandro-matches-selector 2.0.2 ship MIT notices but omit the full license file from their npm packages. Their published READMEs link to the author’s shared MIT license: https://desandro.mit-license.org/ (retrieved 2026-11-04). The adjacent LICENSE preserves that text for redistributable bundles.
